# Gladstone Capital Announces Monthly Cash Distributions for October, November and December 2026 and Conference Call Date


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_2e4b3c0db194592120aa650c0462a8f7/gladstonecapital/news/2026-10-13_Gladstone_Capital_Announces_Monthly_Cash_398.pdf) October 13, 2026 4:15pm EDT


**MCLEAN, VA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / October 13, 2026 /**[Gladstone Capital Corporation](https://pr.report/sbrr) (Nasdaq:GLAD) (the "Company") announced today that its board of directors declared the following monthly cash distributions for October, November and December 2026 and also announced its plan to report earnings for its fourth fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Cash Distributions:**


***Common Stock:*** $0.15 per share of common stock for each of October, November and December 2026, payable per the table below.

The Company offers a dividend reinvestment plan (the "DRIP") to its common stockholders. For more information regarding the DRIP, please visit[www.gladstonecapital.com](https://pr.report/sbrs) .


***Series A Preferred Stock*** (Unlisted): $0.130208 per share of 6.25% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock for each of October, November and December 2026, payable per the table below:

**Earnings Announcement:**


The Company also announced today that it plans to report earnings for the fourth fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the stock market closes on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss its earnings results. Please call (866) 424-3437 to enter the conference call. An operator will monitor the call and set a queue for questions.


A conference call replay will be available after the call and will be accessible through November 25, 2026. To hear the replay, please dial (877) 660-6853 and use playback conference number 13762359.


The live audio broadcast of the Company's conference call will be available online at[www.gladstonecapital.com](https://pr.report/sbrt) . The event will be archived and available for replay on the Company's website.


If you have questions prior to or following the earnings release you may e-mail them tocapital@gladstonecompanies.com .


[Gladstone Capital Corporation](https://pr.report/sbru) is a publicly traded business development company that invests in debt and equity securities consisting primarily of secured first and second lien term loans to lower middle market businesses in the United States. Information on the business activities of all the Gladstone funds can be found at[www.gladstonecompanies.com](https://pr.report/sbrv) .


**Investor Relations Inquiries** : Please visit[www.gladstonecompanies.com](https://pr.report/sbrw) or (703) 287-5893.
